name: Unionism Quartet B2-Style
original_name: ユニオリズム・カルテット B2-STYLE
source:
Three years have passed since Yurina's Union won the Vartok Fehda and the encounter with Tia and Selphie.

The protagonist, Konoe Akito, who became romantically involved with Silveria, accompanied her as her squire on official duties outside the academy. In the days spent supporting her and traveling from Fehda to Fehda across various regions, they came to understand each other better, strengthened their bond, and developed a deep relationship as lovers.

After three years, one day, he received a message asking him to return to the academy after a long absence.

When he returned to the academy, it was as lively as ever, with a slightly nostalgic atmosphere, and overflowing with bunny girls he'd never seen before?!

Tuari Fehda, the ranking tournament for new knight candidates held at the academy, left the academy filled with bunny girls due to its rules. Silveria and Akito, dragged into the Fehda by Stella's scheming, found themselves caught up in the turmoil alongside the other Unionism heroines, who all ended up wearing bunny suits!

This is an afterstory that takes place after Silveria and Akito became lovers, featuring a lighter tone, plenty of bunny girls, and more intense naughty content...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/clip-craft/products/uq_b2s/yuni_b2s_index.html#concept2]official website[/url]]
translation:
自从尤里娜的联盟赢得瓦尔托克费达并与蒂亚和赛尔菲相遇以来，三年过去了。

主人公近卫明人与西尔维莉亚产生了恋情，并作为她的侍从陪伴她在学园外执行公务。在支持她、从费赫达穿越各个地区到费赫达的日子里，他们加深了彼此的了解，加深了感情，结下了深厚的恋人关系。

三年后的某一天，他收到一条消息，要求他重回阔别已久的学院。

回到学院，学院还是一如既往的热闹，还带着一丝怀旧的气息，到处都是他从未见过的兔女郎？！

在学院举办的新晋骑士候补排名赛“Tuari Fehda”，由于其规则，学院里挤满了兔女郎。被斯黛拉的阴谋拖进费达的西尔维亚和秋人，发现自己和其他联合主义女主角一起陷入了混乱，最后她们都穿上了兔子装！

这是发生在Silveria和Akito成为恋人之后的故事，以轻松的语气，大量的兔女郎，以及更激烈的调皮内容……

[翻译自[url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/clip-craft/products/uq_b2s/yuni_b2s_index.html#concept2]官网[/url]]
